title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-016
doc_notes: This is a facility operation log from the Anchorage ARTCC documenting a reported close-approach encounter with an unknown target by Japan Airlines flight 1628.

encounters.summary: A Japan Airlines flight (JL1628) reported an unknown target pacing their aircraft at FL350, exhibiting white and yellow strobe lights, which was also tracked intermittently by radar.
